limitations: Local synthetic fighters; not a production p95 SLA.
Concurrent worker process CPU deltas overlap and are not exclusive request CPU.
Microbench phases are independent probes and cannot be added as a breakdown of executor time.
Identical seeded requests are read-only worker probes; committed API commands and retries are counted separately.
